gloss: right beside, directly to the side

definitions.gloss: right beside, directly to the side
definitions.explanation: Exactly beside something, directly to the left or right with no angle or offset. Emphasizes the precise lateral position.

examples.japanese: {真横|まよこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真横|まよこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a convenience store right next to the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真横|まよこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}して→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧きて⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was startled when a car came flying out from directly beside me.

notes:
{真横|まよこ} uses the prefix {真|ま}〜 (true, exact) attached to ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (side) to mean "directly beside" with no offset. It emphasizes precise lateral position.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {真横|まよこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit right beside
- {真横|まよこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand right beside
- {真横|まよこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from directly beside
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真横|まよこ}: right next to ~

SIMILAR {真|ま}〜 COMPOUNDS:
- {真|ま}{前|まえ}: directly in front
- {真|ま}{後|うし}ろ: directly behind
- ⟦{真上|まうえ}→真上：07784_maue⟧: directly above
- ⟦{真下|ました}→真下：07785_mashita⟧: directly below
- ⟦{真向|まむ}かい→真向かい：16718_mamukai⟧: directly opposite

All these compounds follow the same pattern: {真|ま} + directional word = "directly/exactly" in that direction.
